chapter.heading: A Song of Confidence in God’s Triumph over Evil
chapter.v:
Why do
You stand afar off, O Lord?Why do You hide in times of trouble? [Is. 28:14,]

The wicked
in his pride persecutes the poor;Let them be caught in the plots which they have devised. [Prov. 12:14 great example of this (see Acts 4:36; 9:27; 11:2–30; Gal. 2:1). 1 Cor. 15:33). ter off than the scoffer—the worst kind of fool (see Ps. 1:1).]

For the
wicked boasts of his heart’s desire;He blesses the greedy and renounces the Lord. [Ps. 39:1; Prov. 21:23; [James 3:2]]

The wicked
in his proud countenance does not seek God;God is in none of his thoughts. [Prov. 10:4]

His ways
are always prospering;Your judgments are far above, out of his sight;As for all his enemies, he sneers at them.

He has
said in his heart, “I shall not be moved;I shall never be in adversity.” [Prov. 11:3, 5,]

His mouth
is full of cursing and deceit and oppression;Under his tongue is trouble and iniquity. [[Prov. 11:24; 12:9; Luke 12:20,]

He sits
in the lurking places of the villages;In the secret places he murders the innocent;His eyes are secretly fixed on the helpless.

He lies
in wait secretly, as a lion in his den;He lies in wait to catch the poor;He catches the poor when he draws him into his net. [Job 18:5, 6; 21:17; Prov. 24:20]

So he
crouches, he lies low,That the helpless may fall by his strength. [Prov. 10:12]

He has
said in his heart,“God has forgotten;He hides His face;He will never see.” [Prov. 10:2;]

Arise, O
Lord!O God, lift up Your hand!Do not forget the humble. [Prov. 13:19]

Why do
the wicked renounce God?He has said in his heart,“You will not require an account.” [Num. 15:31; 2 Chr. 36:16; Is.]

But You
have seen, for You observe trouble and grief,To repay it by Your hand.The helpless commits himself to You;You are the helper of the fatherless. [Prov. 6:22; m]

Break the
arm of the wicked and the evil man;Seek out his wickedness until You find none. [Ps. 111:10; Prov. 3:4 1 gives]

The Lord
is King forever and ever;The nations have perished out of His land. [Prov. 12:23]

Lord, You
have heard the desire of the humble;You will prepare their heart;You will cause Your ear to hear, [Prov. 25:13]

To do
justice to the fatherless and the oppressed,That the man of the earth may oppress no more.
